scripts.build: pnpm -C typescript build && pnpm -C python build && pnpm -C rustlang build
scripts.check:lint: vp fmt --check && vp lint && pnpm -C python check:lint && pnpm -C rustlang check:lint
scripts.check:types: tsgo --noEmit && pnpm -C typescript check:types && pnpm -C python check:types && pnpm -C rustlang check:types
scripts.format: vp fmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && pnpm -C python format && pnpm -C rustlang format
scripts.measure:coverage: pnpm -C typescript measure:coverage && pnpm -C python measure:coverage && pnpm -C rustlang measure:coverage
scripts.prepare: lefthook install && node .scripts/link-skills.ts && (command -v uv >/dev/null && pnpm -C python setup || true) && (command -v cargo >/dev/null && pnpm -C rustlang setup || true)
scripts.test:unit: vp test && pnpm -C typescript test:unit && pnpm -C python test:unit && pnpm -C rustlang test:unit
